1.why: The interface uses a clear sans-serif typeface with legible line spacing across all screens.

2.why: Instructions rely on standard sentence case without dense text blocks or forced all-caps styling.

3.why: The single-column view renders cleanly within a mobile-style card container.

4.why: System prompts are concise and written in straightforward language.

5.why: Placeholder text is present in key inputs to illustrate expected formats like code patterns.

6.why: Text across screens is limited to brief paragraphs and structured lists.

7.why: Codes are presented in selectable text fields, though explicit copy-to-clipboard buttons are absent.

8.why: The setup flow displays a text secret and URI string instead of a scannable QR code.

9.why: Standard form inputs are utilized, though explicit browser autofill attributes are not visually confirmed.

10.why: Step headers and main blue call-to-action buttons are visually distinct.

11.why: Each screen limits user interaction to one primary task.

12.why: Green status banners confirm completed actions and guide progression.

13.why: Recovery codes can be regenerated, but retry options on generic failures are limited.

14.why: Error alerts state that a request failed without explaining the root cause or resolution.

15.why: Setup codes expire in five minutes, providing a fixed window rather than unlimited time.
